scope: Opt-in inline/PUREP001 document store on Linux AArch64/GCC 14. The CLI text ceiling is 42 KiB. The HTTP ceiling is 49 KiB after reviewing its 49133-to-49589-byte growth for the authored final-size guard, which checks the locked document version. This is a selected research budget, not the default micro-runtime budget. Direct dependencies only; excludes libc, process RAM, filesystem cache and journal, optional TLS/GTK.
